NEOW.talk.DON_QUIXOTE_CHARACTER_DON_QUIX: [sine]Brave... knight... set out... once more... slay... the Architect...[/sine]
TEZCATARA.talk.DON_QUIXOTE_CHARACTER_DON: What an exquisite [jitter][b]lance[/b][/jitter]. Did you make it, dear?
[i][font_size=22]Takes out the doll that represents Sancho[/font_size][/i]
This little cutie made it? How [jitter][b]beautiful[/b][/jitter]
DARV.talk.DON_QUIXOTE_CHARACTER_DON_QUIX:
Ah, the knight from last time!
So, anything catch your eye today?
What a beautiful relic! Perfect as a memento of this adventure
Heh, I do like someone who knows quality. Take it!
NONUPEIPE.talk.DON_QUIXOTE_CHARACTER_DON: Brave knight, lift your head. You are worthy of my blessing
OROBAS.talk.DON_QUIXOTE_CHARACTER_DON_QU: A knight? Or a bloodfiend? Why are you here?! And with such amusing stories!
How delightful! Take these! Tell me more! More!
PAEL.talk.DON_QUIXOTE_CHARACTER_DON_QUIX: [thinky_dots]The curse upon you comes from your bloodline. Take my flesh, and may it aid you[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.DON_QUIXOTE_CHARACTER_DON_QUIX: [b]Hah!! A gallant duel. A knight like you deserves this weapon![/b]
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DON_QUIXOTE_CHARACTER: You again, knight? Surely you have somewhere else to be?
VAKUU.talk.DON_QUIXOTE_CHARACTER_DON_QUI: Cease your actions at once, bloodfiend! Read the contract, then [jitter]leave immediately[/jitter]!
DON_QUIXOTE_ANCIENT_BARRY.title: Bari
The Knight of the White Moon quietly takes your measure.
DON_QUIXOTE_ANCIENT_BARRY.talk.DON_QUIXO: Long time no see. I have a few things that may help you. Travel well.
DON_QUIXOTE_ANCIENT_BARRY.talk.ANY.0-0.a: I have some supplies here. I hope they help you, adventurer.
DON_QUIXOTE_ANCIENT_SAMSON.title: Samson
DON_QUIXOTE_ANCIENT_SAMSON.talk.DON_QUIX: Elder kin of the fallen La Mancha bloodfiends, first kindred Don Quixote.
If the other elders saw you like this, how their hearts would ache...
